specs.title: project stages save artifacts, evidence and self-assessment; immutable submissions remain available after revisions
a lost save response replays the same request; a stale page preserves local input and can recover
unsaved-stage navigation asks to preserve work and unavailable AI leaves the saved artifact usable
a guardian reviews a learner submission in the curriculum project workspace and the learner keeps its version
all five adult projects complete their three stages and can cite earlier immutable artifacts
actual file versions remain frozen through submission, download, nested preview, editing and responsive layouts
a dropped second chunk resumes the exact selected image after refresh and lost complete acknowledgments do not duplicate it
real PDF previews turn individual pages and closing a playing recording releases its actual audio element
an oversized saved project keeps its full text while the learner explicitly narrows the AI advice scope
